question: What happened to the last western emperor after he was deposed in 476?
answer: He was pensioned off. Odoacer, who had just killed his father Orestes, spared the teenage Romulus Augustulus for his youth and, a chronicler adds, his good looks, gave him 6,000 gold solidi a year and sent him to live freely with relatives in Campania. The western empire ended in a retirement settlement.
move: Grand endings often look, up close, like paperwork.
